comment: A villa's dinner answer for a night gone by, as every lookback must read
it: nightAnswer in nala-shared.js, the one reader behind the Dining
history (Reservations, Guest Profile) and both Statistics tabs. Added
27 Sep, after the lookbacks read the cell alone and every arrival night
answered on the pre-arrival form read as not dined - Statistics listed
a full house as having eaten nothing all week.
The Reservations board's own order for the night: the cell when it is
this booking's, else - on the arrival night only - the guest's form
(formDinnerCell, whose own cases are form_dinner_cases.json). The suites
evaluate the function inside their own loaded page against every case
here - the phone_cases.json pattern. Add cases HERE, not to a suite.
The night's /stays entry is always booking bk-1; stay.arriveOffset is
days from the night to the arrival (0 is the arrival night, negative is
mid-stay), spelt `arrive` as raw /stays spells it. pre is
the booking's prearrival record, null for none, or "unread" for a form
that was not or could not be read. expect is the answer's status and
whether it came from the form, null for no answer, or "unknown" when
only the unread form could have said.

cases.name: the cell answers, whoever gave it
a cell outranks the form, even on the arrival night
an arrival night with no cell is the guest's own form
a no on the form is a no
a form that never reached dinner answers nothing
a booking with no form answers nothing
mid-stay with no cell: the form spoke for the first night only
another booking's cell is not theirs - their form stands on the arrival night
another booking's cell mid-stay leaves no answer at all
a cell with no booking id stands - a walk-in, an old staff entry
a vacant mark is the night's answer, and not a diner
the form unread on the one night it could answer: unknown, never a no
the form unread on a night it could not answer anyway: no answer
the form unread but a cell answers: the cell
